title: Hims & Hers Benefits Adds Grüns, Medjet, Tonal, and Viome for Whole-Body Health and Support
summary: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NYSE: HIMS), the leading health and wellness platform, today announced four new partners joining Hims & Hers Benefits: Grüns®, Medjet®, Tonal™, and Viome™.
body_markdown:
"Building health is an everyday activity. It starts with understanding your body and continues with the right support as it changes, from the strength and nutrition that can complement GLP-1 treatment to knowing you’re covered when you need it most," said Dheerja Kaur, Chief Product Officer at Hims & Hers. "Hims & Hers Benefits brings that support together in one place, so our subscribers can access the tools behind their whole-body health at prices that make a real difference.”


New benefits accessible to subscribers include:


- **Simplify daily nutrition with Grüns.** When GLP-1 treatment changes how much you eat, getting the nutrition you need from food alone can take more effort. Grüns combines more than 60 ingredients, including vitamins, minerals, and prebiotic fiber, into daily gummy packs designed to make comprehensive nutrition a habit that’s easy to keep. Subscribers can receive $30 off their first order.*
- **Get support when you need it most with Medjet.** Medjet is an air medical transport membership for travelers. If you’re hospitalized 150 or more miles from home, Medjet arranges transport to the hospital of your choice in your home country, so you can recover close to your own doctors and family. MedjetHorizon adds 24/7 security and crisis response services. Subscribers can receive approximately 30% off Medjet’s standard retail rates, with MedjetAssist memberships for $215/yr (individual) or $295/yr (family) and MedjetHorizon memberships for $390/yr (individual) or $485/yr (family).*
- **Build strength at home with Tonal.** Tonal 2 is an AI-powered home strength system that uses motor-driven digital weight in place of plates and dumbbells, with real-time form feedback and programs that adapt as you get stronger. Strength training can be a powerful complement to GLP-1 treatment, and Tonal brings it into your living room. Subscribers can receive $1,000 off Tonal 2 hardware.*
- **Make every bite count with Viome.** When you’re eating less, what you eat matters more. Whether you’re beginning a GLP-1 journey or navigating changes along the way, Viome’s Full Body Intelligence™ test provides personalized insights into your microbiome and how your body reacts to your diet. Using RNA sequencing of samples you collect at home, it looks at how your body functions as it changes and delivers personalized food and supplement recommendations to help you make more intentional choices about your nutrition. Subscribers can receive $100 off Full Body Intelligence™ and one free month of Viome Precision Supplements™ with the purchase of two months.*


“So many people already have nutritional gaps, and on a GLP-1, eating less can make good nutrition even harder to keep up with,” said Aaron Jones, Chief Marketing Officer at Grüns. “We’re excited to help Hims & Hers subscribers make daily nutrition something they look forward to.”


“Illness and injury while traveling are things you hope never happen," said John Gobbels, CEO of Medjet. “By partnering with Hims & Hers, we’re helping more people travel knowing that if the unexpected does occur, they can get to a hospital they trust, close to home.”


“Every health journey is different, but strength belongs in all of them,” said Derek Mellencamp, Chief Revenue Officer at Tonal. “It’s the foundation for how you move, how you feel, and how well you can live for years to come. Tonal tracks your progress every step of the way, so you can see and feel yourself getting stronger. With Hims & Hers as a partner, that progress is in reach for many more people.”


"There’s no one-size-fits-all approach to nutrition, especially as your body’s needs evolve. Viome was built to help individuals better understand their unique nutritional requirements and make it easier to take meaningful actions to improve their health. Through Hims & Hers Benefits, more subscribers can get access to personalized nutrition recommendations and fill their nutrition gaps with supplements formulated for their body’s needs," said Shannon Pappas, President of Consumer Business at Viome.


Underpinning the company's commitment to put its customers first, Hims & Hers does not profit from these benefits. Instead, 100% of the negotiated benefits are passed directly to active subscribers.
